title: "[FEATURE]: "

type: Feature

---

**Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.**

A clear and concise description of what the problem is. Ex. I'm always frustrated when the bot doesn't notify me that my GitHub PR was closed...

**Describe the solution you'd like**

A clear and concise description of what you want the bot to do (e.g. "Add a `/github track` slash command", or "Create a button on the welcome message that...").

**Describe alternatives you've considered**

A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered (e.g. using a different bot, managing roles manually, or using custom webhooks).

**Additional context**

Add any other context, mockup screenshots of Discord embeds, or flowcharts about the feature request here.
